name: Introduction to Computer Architecture - Task 1
description: This task covers Chapter 1.1: Introduction to Computer Architecture. Students will understand what computer architecture means, identify major components (CPU, memory hierarchy, I/O), and distinguish between architecture and implementation.

tasks.name: Study Task 1: Introduction to Computer Architecture
tasks.description: Read Chapter 1.1 Introduction to Computer Architecture. Note definitions, key terms, and explain CPU, memory hierarchy, I/O, and the difference between computer architecture and computer organization. Summarize findings and create a mind map.
